scientific_integrity: One exact all-parameter theorem; older edge-basis state enumeration is explicitly excluded from novelty. Reproducible independent scripts and outputs are embedded. Scientific claims are same-model reviewed, not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: For n>=3 connected crown graphs, ordinary vertex-metric bases and adjacency-constrained token slides only. All-pairs distances verified computationally for n=3..8, sampled for n=9..11; infinite statement is proved symbolically. Historical priority against an inaccessible 2026 thesis and one abstract-only crown paper is not fully cleared.
title: Sharp token-slide diameter of crown-graph metric bases
